axis: Target distance only. Same selected one-hour reclaim clock, same entries and identical matched random clocks, 5 percent stop and max 168 hours.
baseline: Reuse original near edge without cap. Only move targets inward when farther away than cap.
selection: Choose best by early mean net PnL from the two caps and unchanged baseline, show all post-2024 results. Cap choices informed by pooled exploratory MFE and are not prospective validation.
fees: 0.05 percent taker on entry/stop/timeout, 0.02 percent maker on target; stress adds 5bp to each market fill
